distribution: Windows x64 PyInstaller ONEDIR + Inno Setup 6

clinical_compatibility.prescription_source: Desktop/JAB primary; MySQL fallback remains XOR-guarded
clinical_compatibility.knowledge_base: Application upgrade never changes the Published KB or DRAFT lifecycle
clinical_compatibility.commissioning: Fresh install uses Admin-led RALAN/RANAP and source onboarding; existing valid RALAN/RANAP and MySQL/Desktop source are preserved

security: No credentials, passwords, secrets, or patient data are included in the installer.

khanza_bridge.selection: Automatic from the verified Khanza JVM architecture
khanza_bridge.upgrade_behavior: Existing E-MAS KhanzaBridge helper processes are stopped before all bundled bridge binaries are replaced; only the selected persistent bridge is started.
